hypothesis: A zero-gated hybrid that preserves a bounded downstream adapter and adds causal raw-input access will beat both an exact-size downstream-only adapter and the immutable no-intervention baseline on source-disjoint action accuracy and macro-F1.

compact_action_input.construction: Sorted full-vocabulary IDs observed in actual multiview action-training inputs plus full-vocabulary ID zero as a causal anchor. Any unmapped action input fails closed.

architecture.initialization_gate: Candidate and matched-control action logits must be bit-identical on the exact initial probes within the execution runtime.

requirements: Every compact embedding row occurs in the actual action-training input tensors, including row zero through the causal anchor.
A deterministic witness over actual action-training rows gives every selected scalar in both arms a nonzero gradient path after opening the zero projections.
A deterministic two-step update over actual action-training rows changes all 140820 selected scalars in both arms.
A completed training arm with fewer than 140820 changed selected scalars fails the producer gate.

storage.training_measurement: Measure the exact existing filesystem containing live campaign checkpoints; Path.anchor or a different mount is invalid.
storage.durable_copy: Atomically copy hash-verified checkpoint generations and terminal receipts from training scratch to a separately measured durable output filesystem.
storage.prohibition: The 25 GiB training floor cannot be lowered, substituted with the durable-output guard, or satisfied by another filesystem.

evaluation.split: source-disjoint held-diagonal holdout, 1500 examples per seed
evaluation.variance_gate: Positive mean delta greater than two pooled standard deviations for both metrics against both controls.
evaluation.finite_accuracy: Two-sided exact McNemar with candidate wins greater than losses and p <= 0.0125 against each control.
evaluation.finite_macro_f1: Deterministic seed-and-target-stratified paired bootstrap with 10000 replicates and one-sided lower bound > 0 against each control.
evaluation.retention: Exact parent counting score plus byte-identical frozen and non-selected tensors for every trained arm.
evaluation.independent_replay: Rebuild held inputs and targets from pinned authorities, reload sealed models, and recompute predictions, metrics, effective-capacity gate, and decision gates.

checkpointing.format: two-slot atomic checkpoints with hash-checked latest pointer
checkpointing.resume: Completed arms are fully replayed before reuse; partial arms restore optimizer, sampler, ledger, RNG, step, and generation.
checkpointing.prior_cloud_output: A new cloud version may import only an exact externally pinned recovery manifest from a private prior-output dataset.

stop_conditions: Any lineage, preregistration, packet, parent, dataset, or recovery hash differs.
The exact training scratch filesystem has fewer than 27917287424 free bytes at launch or falls below the 26843545600-byte floor before a segment.
The durable output filesystem has fewer than 1073741824 free bytes before a copy.
Selected or effective capacity differs from 140820 in either trained arm.
Initial logits differ, causality fails, an unmapped action token is admitted, or any frozen/non-selected tensor changes.
Loss is non-finite, checkpoint recovery fails, or independent replay differs.
claim_boundary: This preregistration authorizes local mechanics, packet staging, and a later separately authorized private controlled discovery run. It does not authorize upload, launch, publication, merge, or weight promotion.
